desc: Ideation and algorithm design (distance BFS with middle-layer and branch analysis).
Implement BFS from S and T to compute distS and distT.
Handle dist == 1 case: check for common neighbor of S and T; output 3 or -1.
Handle even dist case: check for two middle vertices or one middle vertex with a branch neighbor; output 2d, 2d+2, or -1.
Handle odd dist case: check for edge on shortest path with common neighbor or branch neighbor; output 2d+1, 2d+2, or -1.
Test on sample inputs and verify correctness.
